title: PILLAGERS DRAWN A THIRD THE SIZE
why: His note of 2026-10-25, played on the old build 33.17, where the figure was drawn at 1.25: player character is still wayyy too big, needs to be 1/3 of the size he is right now. So every human figure (both players, the pillager bots, hires, the survivor, the peddler, downed and falling bodies, the Undercroft crowd) is drawn at a third of what he saw: FIG_SCALE 1.25/3, about 0.42 of the size 1 art (34.83 drew 0.8), drawing only: hit areas, walking, doors and the nav grid keep their old radius. FIG_UP now follows FIG_SCALE, so every plate and tag keeps the gap over the head it had on the size 1 figure. Things placed for the full size body follow it: the side mark, the world muzzle flash with the tracer start and the brass, the forge glow, the DEMO spawn shield, the power shield bubble, the waterline, the HUD plates over your head (cook, reload, seal, forge), the get-up bar (now just over the head of a bot rising in a crouch, under his nameplate), the peddler pack frame, the fall shadow and the ascent sink. The golden body pass draws the golden pillager on its own canvas, where figOn() was false, so he was drawn at size 1 (2.4 times the others with this change); figOn() now knows that pass, and the golden and the outlined elite body (rimOpen) send their ground shadow back to the world canvas with the transform the body is drawn with, so they stand on a shadow of their own size. The forge element effects on a pillager, the survivor and the peddler (flames, shock, the ice block, the chill ring, acid) were fitted to the 0.8 body (elemBodyH 34, the hit radius for the width): they follow the drawn body now (elemBodyK, FIG_SCALE/0.8), and machines and the pixel look keep theirs. The HUD plates over your head take the head part of their lift in world units times ZOOM and the gap in HUD px times hudRes (figHudLift, the way the bot plates already lift), so they sit just over the drawn head at 1080, at 4K, zoomed in and aimed; measured at 4K on 34.85, the reload bar was drawn across the head. The P1 and P2 seat ring and the red downed ring keep their full size so they still read. In the pixel look (its own size, PIX_FIGK) the plates keep the lift they had (figUpL, FIG_UP 4 there) and the aim dots no longer take FIG_SCALE, so they start at the pixel gun.
now: Every pillager, bot, hire and body is drawn at a third of the size you saw on the old copy (build 33.17), about half of the size on the newest build (drawing only: hit areas, walking and doors keep their old size). Name plates, party tags, the shields, the muzzle flash, the golden pillager and the fire and ice of forged guns follow the smaller body, and the reload bar and the grenade timer sit just over his head on the 4K screen and when aiming too (on the newest build the reload bar was drawn across his head at 4K); the P1 and P2 seat rings and the red downed ring keep their full size so they still read. Watch for: the small body being hard to spot in a fight or on the big screen, shots that look like misses still hitting (the hit circle is now much bigger than the body), the crowbar reaching further than its swing looks, tracers starting a little above the gun, the round hatch you ascend from looking big under you, the Undercroft crowd looking small next to the stations, and the bodies on the ground looking about twice the size of a standing pillager.
